# In-situ monitoring: optics and data numbers (generated by analysis/optics/monitoring_optics.py)

## Coaxial camera through the f-theta and galvo

- Return pupil 18.0 mm (the Ø1 in. dichroic at 45°), NA 0.0561: Rayleigh 9.2 µm at 850 nm.
- 850 nm focuses 1.05 mm off the 1070 nm focus (fused-silica singlet estimate): refocus the camera, not the lens.
- An 850 ± 20 nm band spreads focus over 0.22 mm: 12.4 µm blur at full NA, 6.6 µm stopped to NA 0.03. A ±5 nm filter cuts it four-fold.
- Lateral colour moves the 850 nm view off the 1070 nm spot by ~166 µm at the M50 edge and ~249 µm at the L75 edge: map the spot's position in the frame against galvo angle.

| camera | magnification | tube lens f (mm) | field at 8 µm/px (mm) | frame rate | sensor refocus (mm) |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| Raspberry Pi Global Shutter (IMX296) | 0.431 | 69 | 1.02 × 0.77 | 536 | 0.19 |
| Kron Chronos 2.1-HD | 1.25 | 200 | 5.12 × 0.77 | 24,046 | 1.63 |
| Mikrotron EoSens 3CL (NIST AMMT's) | 1.0 | 160 | 0.96 × 0.96 | 10,000 | 1.05 |

## Thermal sensing on aluminium

Lowest true temperature a 0.80 µm camera (Optris PI 08M band) can show, from its apparent-temperature floor:

| apparent floor | ε = 0.1 | ε = 0.2 | ε = 0.35 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 575 °C apparent at 0.80 µm | 678 °C | 645 °C | 619 °C |
| 625 °C apparent at 0.80 µm | 742 °C | 703 °C | 675 °C |
| 750 °C apparent at 0.80 µm | 904 °C | 853 °C | 815 °C |

Signal from a 1,800 K melt pool over solid metal at 600 °C, per band (the dynamic range one detector must span):

- 0.7 µm: 183,753×
- 0.9 µm: 12,430×
- 1.55 µm: 240×
- 4.0 µm: 9×

Solidification ranges (solidus, liquidus, °C): 6061 582–652; 7075 477–635; AlSi10Mg 557–596
